craft_notes: Sthāyin: kiss-wonder. Close: host. Rejected: explaining the kiss — killed, literal kept; 'yogi' for naraḥ — killed: man kept.

lines: Who minds it for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed —
he binds then body and the mantra-seal-host.
l4.sanskrit_cite: muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ

reads_against.argmap: Remembering a moment in kiss, navel-sealed, he binds body and host.
c1_essence: Moment remembered in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
